subject: URGENT: OptimaHealth - spike in 5xx and p95 latency in us-west3 (AZ3) - routing assistance requested
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@optimahealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@optimahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production traffic - us-west3 errors and latency

Hi Lauren,

We're seeing a sudden spike in 5xx errors and p95 latency for our production traffic routed to us-west3 (AZ3) starting ~14:50 PDT. Response times climbed from ~120ms to 2.3s and roughly 3% of requests are 5xx. Our customers are complaining. Attached is a screenshot from our dashboard and a short capture of failing requests.

Can Redwood temporarily reroute our traffic away from us-west3 while you investigate? We need a low-risk path; Optima prefers a cross-region pin to us-west2 if possible — we can accept a brief cold-cache hit.

Alex Chen
SRE Lead, OptimaHealth
alex.chen@optimahealth.com
[Attachment: optima-incident-screenshot.png (image/png)]
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production traffic - us-west3 errors and latency

Team — forwarding Optima's note. Immediate ask: route consent + quick mitigation plan. Key asks:
- Temporary cross-region pin off us-west3 -> us-west2 for Optima (low risk, brief cache miss)
- Keep Optima ondedicated routing policy but change route target; preserve auth and logging.
- Provide immediate ETA for root cause (resource saturation vs infra fault).

Attached: Optima screenshot. I captured a quick sample trace in Console (INC-5591).

Hannah — can you validate capacity on us-west2 and the routing policy change path?
Rishi — any known AZ3 anomalies right now?
Vanessa — I'll need exec comms template and a proposed credit offer if we have to fail over them for >30m.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production traffic - us-west3 errors and latency

On Mon, 22 Apr 2029 at 15:28, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hannah — can you validate capacity on us-west2 and the routing policy change path?
> Rishi — any known AZ3 anomalies right now?

Checked infra: us-west3 telemetry shows CPU utilization on several inference hosts at sustained 98-100% for last 20m and evictions on the runtime (KV cache pressure). There are correlated kernel-level warnings in the Node agent logs. No active maintenance or scheduled change.

Capacity in us-west2: we have ~25% spare headroom in the Dedicated pool for Optima's reserved lanes, and we can accept additional traffic at lower priority if we enable burst capacity. Routing change steps (low friction):
1) Create a routing override for Optima's tenant id -> prefer us-west2 model endpoints (can be done in Console, no code deploy)
2) Flip weight from us-west3:100 -> us-west2:90/us-west3:10 to smooth cold-cache
3) Monitor p95 and 5xx for 15m, then ramp to us-west2:100 if stable

I will push a config change now and attach logs. Attaching a small archive with debug snippets (server traces, p95 chart).

[Attachment: debug-logs-az3-20290422.tar.gz (application/gzip)]
[Attachment: p95-latency-chart.png (image/png)]

Hannah
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@optimahealth.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@optimahealth.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 19:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Production traffic - us-west3 errors and latency

Alex / Jordan — quick status and proposed next steps: 

What we did (18:05 PDT - 18:20 PDT):
- Initiated Optima tenant routing override to prefer us-west2. Ramped to 90% us-west2 / 10% us-west3 for initial safety.
- Enabled Dedicated burst capacity for Optima in us-west2.
- Observed p95 drop from 2.3s -> 210ms and 5xx down to 0.2% within 6 minutes.

Current status (19:03 PDT):
- Traffic fully routed to us-west2. Metrics stable; no new 5xx spikes.
- We captured node-level traces from AZ3; early indicators point to KV cache eviction bug under specific workload patterns (inflight continuous batching). Rishi will open a follow-up internal SEV on that.

Next steps:
- Rishi to publish SEV-PR postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow with root cause & mitigation timeline.
- Vanessa to propose a goodwill credit: 20% bill credit for the 2 hours of elevated error/latency, plus a committed health-check review within the month.
- Lauren to schedule a 30-minute customer bridge for tomorrow 9:00 PDT to walk through what happened and the long-term safeguards.

Optima — do you want us to keep the permanent pin to us-west2 for the next 48 hours while we finish the investigation, or should we revert to standard routing once your traffic stabilizes? If you choose to remain pinned, we'll prioritize a quicker fix track.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast responses.

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
